description: Statutory Maternity, Paternity and Shared Parental Pay from usual pay before tax, week by week, with any employer top-up of full pay then half pay: the total, each week's pay, and how far short of usual pay it falls. Use for 'what will I get on maternity leave on £35k', 'how much is paternity pay'.

fullPayWeeks.description: Employer top-up: whole weeks at full pay from the first week of leave, 0 to 52. Defaults to 0.

halfPayMode.description: including: half pay with the statutory pay in it; plus: half pay on top of the statutory pay, never more than full pay. The employer's policy says which. Defaults to including.

halfPayWeeks.description: Then whole weeks at half pay. Full and half pay together up to 52. Defaults to 0.

kind.description: maternity for the parent who gave birth, paternity for their partner.

pay.description: Usual pay before tax, after any salary sacrifice - the average in the 8 weeks up to the 15th week before the due week.

per.description: Whether pay is a year's, a month's or a week's.

sharedWeeks.description: Whole weeks of Shared Parental Pay after them: for maternity, up to the weeks of maternity pay not taken (39 less statutoryWeeks); for a partner, up to 37, if the birth parent stops early to share. Defaults to 0.

statutoryWeeks.description: Whole weeks of maternity pay, 2 to 39 (defaults to 39), or of paternity pay, 0 to 2 (defaults to 2).

name: calculate_parental_pay
title: Parental Leave Pay
